title: MHADA Pune lottery: MahaIT services down until 21 Oct, deadline still 22 Oct
audience: Marathi families in Pune and PCMC applying for the MHADA Pune lottery 2026 (EWS/LIG, first home), 22-50
message: MahaIT services are down until 21 October, the last date is still 22 October and no extension is announced: keep everything ready, and we will tell you if the date changes.
facts: MHADA's notice: MahaIT related portal services remain unavailable from 16 October 2026 (4 pm) to 21 October 2026, for technical maintenance by MahaIT. Source: mhada.gov.in Pune page, read 17 October 2026.
MahaIT handles the domicile and income certificate checks for the lottery application. Source: Mahaenews, 17 October 2026.
The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is still 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm (23:59). Source: MHADA Pune board, extension of 14 October 2026.
Deposit paid by RTGS or NEFT from a bank is accepted until 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm (15:59). Source: MHADA Pune board.
No further extension has been announced as of 17 October 2026. Source: Mahaenews, 17 October 2026; MHADA's site shows none.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site.

shots.prompt: A Marathi couple in their early 30s at a simple dining table in a small rented flat in the evening, the wife holding a phone and filling in an online form, the husband leaning in with a hopeful look. A plain wall behind them with nothing on it.
shots.voice: MHADA पुणे लॉटरीचा अर्ज अडकलाय? हे आधी ऐका.

shots.prompt: Close-up over the shoulder of a woman's hands holding a phone, about to tap a button, a cup of tea and a small notebook on a wooden table, soft evening light, the phone screen blurred and unreadable.
shots.voice: महा-आयटीच्या सेवा 16 ऑक्टोबर दुपारपासून 21 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत बंद आहेत.

shots.prompt: A quiet dim room of a Pune flat late at night, a phone glowing on a table, a sleeping city seen through the window, a calm but urgent mood. No clock, no calendar.
shots.voice: पण शेवटची तारीख अजूनही 22 ऑक्टोबर, रात्री 11:59 आहे.

shots.prompt: A man in his 30s at the counter of a public sector bank branch in Pune handing a payment slip to the cashier, a simple bank interior, other customers blurred in the background, no signboards.
shots.voice: बँकेतून RTGS ने भरणार असाल, तर 23 ऑक्टोबर दुपारी 3:59 पर्यंत.

shots.prompt: New affordable apartment towers, 12 to 14 floors, plain cream and light-orange paint, on the edge of Pune at sunset, a few families walking on the road in front, construction cranes far away, no signboards.
shots.voice: मुदतवाढीची घोषणा अजून नाही. कागदपत्रं आणि पैसे तयार ठेवा.

shots.prompt: The same kind of young Marathi couple standing on a small balcony of a new flat at golden hour, smiling and looking at the view, a few plants in pots, happy and hopeful.
shots.voice: तारीख बदलली तर आम्ही लगेच सांगू. फॉलो करा.

hook: MHADA पुणे लॉटरी: महा-आयटी सेवा 21 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत बंद, शेवटची तारीख अजून 22 ऑक्टोबर
caption:
MHADA Pune Lottery 2026 update | म्हाडा पुणे लॉटरी: महा-आयटी सेवा बंद, शेवटची तारीख काय?

⚠️ MHADA च्या सूचनेनुसार महा-आयटीशी संबंधित पोर्टल सेवा 16 ऑक्टोबर (दुपारी 4) ते 21 ऑक्टोबर 2026 पर्यंत बंद आहेत. अधिवास आणि उत्पन्न दाखल्याची पडताळणी याच सेवांमधून होते.

📅 अर्ज आणि ऑनलाइन पेमेंटची शेवटची तारीख अजूनही: 22 ऑक्टोबर, रात्री 11:59
🏦 RTGS / NEFT: 23 ऑक्टोबर, दुपारी 3:59 पर्यंत
❓ मुदतवाढ: 17 ऑक्टोबरपर्यंत अधिकृत घोषणा नाही

✅ कागदपत्रं आणि अनामत रक्कम तयार ठेवा. सेवा सुरू होताच अर्ज पूर्ण करा, शेवटच्या दिवसाची वाट पाहू नका.

🔔 तारीख बदलली तर आम्ही लगेच पोस्ट करू. फॉलो करा, अर्ज करणाऱ्या मित्राला पाठवा.

🌐 अधिकृत साइट: https://housing.mhada.gov.in/
⚠️ अर्ज फक्त अधिकृत साइटवर करा. अर्जासाठी कोणालाही पैसे देऊ नका.

व्हिडिओतील छायाचित्रे प्रतीकात्मक आहेत.

reply_facts: MHADA's notice says MahaIT related portal services are unavailable from 16 October 2026, 4 pm, to 21 October 2026, for technical maintenance by MahaIT; MahaIT handles the domicile and income certificate checks.
The last date to apply and pay the deposit online is still 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm; RTGS/NEFT payment by 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm. No further extension had been announced as of 17 October 2026.
The draw is planned for 4 December 2026.
The homes in this lottery are located in Pune city, Pimpri-Chinchwad and the PMRDA area only.
Applications are made only on MHADA's official site; Avasetu does not take applications or money.
The pictures in the reel are illustrations, not the lottery's actual buildings.

reply_faq.q: Site is not working, portal down, server down, certificate verification stuck, domicile or income certificate pending?
reply_faq.a: MHADA's notice says MahaIT related services are down from 16 October, 4 pm, to 21 October 2026 for maintenance, and the certificate checks go through them. Keep your documents and the deposit ready and finish as soon as the services are back.

reply_faq.q: Will the date be extended, is there an extension, mudatvadh?
reply_faq.a: No extension had been announced as of 17 October; the last date is still 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm. If MHADA changes it, we will post it straight away.

reply_faq.q: What is the last date, RTGS NEFT payment last date, was it 15 October?
reply_faq.a: Apply and pay the deposit online by 22 October 2026, 11:59 pm (extended on 14 October from 15 October). By RTGS/NEFT from your bank, by 23 October 2026, 3:59 pm.

reply_faq.q: How do I check whether my payment went through, application status, receipt?
reply_faq.a: Log in on MHADA's official housing site with the username you made when you registered; your application and its status show on your dashboard. Keep the receipt you got after paying.

reply_faq.q: Where do I apply, which site, apply kahan karna hai?
reply_faq.a: Only on MHADA's official housing site (the link is in the caption). Avasetu does not take applications or money, and nobody needs to be paid to apply.

reply_faq.q: When is the draw, result date?
reply_faq.a: The draw is planned for 4 December 2026. If MHADA changes the date, we will post it.

reply_faq.q: Where are the homes, is it in Nashik, Sambhajinagar, Nagpur, Wardha or another district?
reply_faq.a: The homes in this MHADA Pune board lottery are only in Pune city, Pimpri-Chinchwad and the PMRDA area. Other districts come under other MHADA boards with their own lotteries; we will post about them soon.

reply_faq.q: Are these the actual flats in the video?
reply_faq.a: No, the pictures in the video are illustrations. The actual homes, their prices and sizes are listed scheme by scheme on MHADA's official site.
